verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own API Key plugin lets you create, manage and verify API keys. It documents constraints such as custom expiration, remaining-use counts, refills and built-in rate limiting, plus organization-owned keys. The homepage also claims auth for AI agents with token exchange and agent delegation. However, no evidence shows per-key permission scopes or least-privilege grants for agent credentials; the limits shown are about usage and lifetime, not privilege. missing for 10: documented per-key permission/scope assignment, agent-specific credential issuance docs for delegation/token exchange, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: The API Key plugin allows you to create and manage API keys for your application. It provides a way to authenticate and authorize API requests by verifying API keys.
Custom expiration times, remaining count, and refill systems
Organization-owned API keys in addition to user-owned keys
Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation.
